head: codex/10-v092-wp24-article-series
title: [v0.92][WP-24] Complete the ten-article ADL launch series
body:
Closes #10

Completes the source-grounded WP-24 launch series in the canonical repository: ten bounded source packets, ten full Medium-style article drafts, ten editorial reviews, a cross-series claim matrix, and a stop-before-publish disposition.

This revision also reconciles migration authority after review: canonical issue #10 and PR #14 are authoritative, legacy issue danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5844 is closed as superseded provenance, legacy PR danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5902 is closed unmerged, and current canonical main is integrated. A focused regression now rejects stale null-PR, pending-publication, or dual-authority migration evidence.

Validation:
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb --negative`
- `ruby .csdlc/evidence/5844/validate-article-series.rb --rollback`
- `bash adl/tools/test_medium_article_writer_skill_contracts.sh`
- typed C-SDLC issue validation and exact diff hygiene

Review:
- Claude and Gemini editorial evidence is retained without credentials.
- Linnaeus approved exact head `4fe438af3`, including live canonical/legacy issue and PR readback, current-main ancestry, migration regression proof, unchanged article content, and the stop-before-publish boundary.

External Medium publication remains operator-only and is not authorized by this PR. Release-dependent wording remains gated by legacy issue danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5843 and a final drift-prone claim recheck.
